Figure is the CP 2026 column of the CDMT's activity table, which carries only Financement intérieur: all 31 ministries' CDMT totals equal the PLF's domestic column to within 1,000 francs of rounding. Appropriated: the CDMT was printed on 22/12/2025, after the Assembly's vote, and Loi n°25.015's recap by ministry (Loi votée, law pp. 19-22) carries the same section totals as the bill; the law annexes the bill's detail. Cross-foot: every activity sums to its action, every action to its programme and every programme to its section (472 parents, zero differences). source_slug is the companion page of the volume doc_locator names first (notes-for-corpus 48).
